title: Base components (OLED)
question: Which component style should the whole app use?

variants.label: Soft pills
variants.notes: Fully rounded buttons, inputs and toasts, the style used in the mocks so far. Friendly, a bit airy. Sheet: buttons, inputs with error, switches/checkboxes/radios/segmented, status badges, progress and skeleton, toasts, menu, delete confirmation, sudo unlock, empty state, tooltip.

variants.label: Rounded rectangles
variants.notes: Same colours, tighter: 12px corners, smaller controls, focus ring on inputs. Fits dense pages like Services and Logs better. Sheet: buttons, inputs with error, switches/checkboxes/radios/segmented, status badges, progress and skeleton, toasts, menu, delete confirmation, sudo unlock, empty state, tooltip.

variants.label: Chunky and tactile
variants.notes: Bigger controls, buttons with a pressed edge, toasts in the accent colour. Most playful, easiest on touch screens. Sheet: buttons, inputs with error, switches/checkboxes/radios/segmented, status badges, progress and skeleton, toasts, menu, delete confirmation, sudo unlock, empty state, tooltip.
